test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

Each participant who registered online for the event (1)/ were given a welcome kit (2)/ along with the program schedule and map (3)/ at the helpdesk near the entrance. (4)/

options.text: at the helpdesk near the entrance. (4)
along with the program schedule and map (3)
Each participant who registered online for the event (1)

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the use of the verb "**were**" in part 2 of the sentence.
 
• The subject of the sentence, "**Each participant**," is singular, so it requires a singular verb.
 
• The correct verb should be "**was**" instead of "**were**."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Each participant who registered online for the event **was** given a welcome kit along with the program schedule and map at the helpdesk near the entrance."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1: "Each participant who registered online for the event"** – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 3: "along with the program schedule and map"** – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "at the helpdesk near the entrance"** – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 2.
